Id.description: Unique identifier of the rate. If it matches an existing rate, that rate will be updated. If no match is found, an error will be returned.

ExternalIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the rate in the external system. If `Id` is not provided and `ExternalIdentifier` matches an existing rate, the corresponding rate will be updated. If no match is found, a new rate will be created.

ServiceId.description: Unique identifier of the service. Ignored in case of updating an existing rate.

RateGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the rate group under which rate is assigned. Empty value means that rate is added to a default group or the current group is kept for update, respectively.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the rate is available to customers. `true` will be used as a default if not provided.

Type.title: Rate Add Type
Type.description:
Type of the rate. `Private` will be used as a default if not provided.
